Howell Ogunlesi Family Professor of Business Administration Ogunlesi Family Professor of Business Administration Sabrina Howell is the Ogunlesi Family Professor of Business Administration​ at Harvard Business School. Howell is also a Research Associate at the National Bureau of Economic Research and a Research Fellow at the Institute for Private Capital, among other affiliations. Professor Howell’s research focuses on entrepreneurial finance, private equity, innovation, fintech, and China. A theme across her work is relevance to policymakers and practitioners. She teaches Entrepreneurial Finance in the MBA
